title: Húsvétkor, szilveszterkor: Last Year and Next

sections.title: A holiday in the past and in the future
sections.content: You know *-kor* from A1 for clock times (*nyolckor*). A holiday takes it too: *húsvétkor* ("at Easter"), *szilveszterkor* ("on New Year's Eve"). For last year you know *tavaly* (Unit 24) and the past of *van*: *voltam*, *voltunk* (Unit 24). For plans you know *fog* + infinitive (Unit 27) and the present with *majd* (Unit 11).

items.english: Last New Year's Eve we were at home.
Last Easter I was at Gábor's.
On New Year's Eve we will celebrate with Petra.
On New Year's Day we will eat lentils.

sections.content: *-kor* goes on the holiday itself (*húsvétkor*). For a date you use *-án/-én* (*január elsején*). When a word is in focus, *fog* follows it: *Petrával fogunk ünnepelni*.
